record.additionalConstraints: 1. Students electing to take Music studio must arrange for an audition before the Music faculty. Normally, a level of performance equivalent to about Grade Eight standing at the Royal Conservatory of Music of Toronto is expected for admission to Music studio. Non-western musical instruments will also be considered at the discretion of the Department.

      • MUSIC222 - Conducting 1 (0.50)
      • MUSIC232 - Music as a Global Phenomenon (0.50)
      • MUSIC233 - Musical Rhythms of the World (0.50)

      • MUSIC251 - European Music History 2: Romantic and Modern Eras (0.50)

record.declarationRequirements: • Though not required, for students considering a Performance Specialization it is normally a good idea to include Music studio courses in first year. However, acceptance into studio courses does not itself constitute admission to a Music academic plan.
record.specializationDetails: Students may choose to focus their elective choices by completing one of four available specializations.
record.graduationRequirements:
• See Bachelor of Arts degree-level requirements.
  • Complete a total of 6.0 units of MUSIC courses.
  • Participate in a least four terms of Music Ensemble: which may not be counted towards the total 6.0 units.
